rules.twins: A = rest + (r1, X) + (r2, Y), B = rest + (r1, Y) + (r2, X); X ≠ Y drawn uniformly from the fillers observed under both r1 and r2 (distinct texts); rest = a donor frame with exactly one r1 and one r2 filler (not held out, not synthetic), category edges kept, other fillers resampled frequency-weighted (never X or Y); every frame new
rules.candidates: [X, Y] in this order for both twins and both relations
rules.scoring: choice: PMI against the null prompt; cloze: per-token log-probability minus the null prompt's; twin contrast z = ±[(s_A(X) − s_A(Y)) − (s_B(X) − s_B(Y))]
